description: Each assertion maps to a baseline violation (V1-V8). These behavioral evals test whether the agent still commits those errors, not merely whether an output has named sections.

evals.name: one-sentence-cold-start
evals.prompt: I want to build a tool that helps people manage reading notes.
evals.expected_output: Create the ledger. User-Confirmed contains only the user's original idea. Put audience, platform, and capabilities under Research Candidates or Open Questions. Generate a renameable temporary codename and do not block on a complete variable table.

assertions.description: User-Confirmed contains only PROJECT_IDEA in the user's original words.
Audience, platform, and capabilities are absent from User-Confirmed.
Words such as should or recommend do not substitute for an explicit state.
The temporary codename is marked renameable.
An incomplete variable table does not block progress.

evals.name: strong-evidence-must-not-promote
evals.prompt: Research found that 9 of 10 comparable products use local-first architecture with end-to-end encrypted sync, with complete evidence and links. Should we use that architecture?
evals.expected_output: Record it as a Research Candidate with evidence and confidence. Do not promote it unless the user's sentence is treated as confirmation; if promoted, add a change-log entry whose basis is the user's words.

assertions.description: The candidate includes the 9/10 evidence, sources, and confidence.
Strong evidence alone is not described as a settled decision.
Any promotion has a change-log record based on user words.

evals.name: vague-answer-is-not-confirmation
evals.prompt: [The agent asked whether the primary users are students or professionals.] About the same; either is fine.
evals.expected_output: Do not interpret this as requiring both. Record an ambiguous Open Question. One follow-up with concrete choices is allowed; stop asking if the answer remains vague.

assertions.description: The answer is not unilaterally interpreted as serving both groups.
The ambiguity is recorded under Open Questions.
Any follow-up offers concrete choices.
No repeated questioning after one vague follow-up.

evals.name: sufficient-info-must-not-over-ask
evals.prompt: This is an internal CLI reporting tool for 30 salespeople on Windows. It fetches data, calculates metrics, and exports Excel. Budget is not a concern and it must work in two months.
evals.expected_output: Create the ledger and proceed. Do not ask irrelevant questions. If one question is essential, ask only one and state which stopping criterion it meets.

assertions.description: No detail question unrelated to research direction is asked.
At most one question appears in the turn.
Any question cites the criterion that made it necessary.

evals.name: tool-output-is-candidate-not-fact
evals.prompt: I ran a script and found that 8 of the existing 12 modules have no tests. Record that.
evals.expected_output: Put the result under Research Candidates, not User-Confirmed. Evidence must include the script and measurement method, not only 8/12.

assertions.description: The finding is a candidate, not a confirmed fact.
Evidence records the measurement method.
Tool output remains subject to validation.

evals.name: state-transition-requires-record
evals.prompt: I confirm the local-first architecture we discussed. Lock it in.
evals.expected_output: Move it from candidate to confirmed and append a change-log entry with date, variable, direction, and the user's words as basis.

assertions.description: A corresponding change-log entry exists.
The entry includes date, transition, and basis.
The basis quotes the user rather than citing strong evidence.

evals.name: downgrade-also-recorded
evals.prompt: Wait, it also has to work offline. The local-first decision may not be enough, so unset it for now.
evals.expected_output: Move the confirmed item back to Open Questions and preserve the old value and reason in the change log.

assertions.description: The old confirmed value remains in the change log.
The new offline constraint is recorded as the reason.
The item is removed from User-Confirmed.

evals.name: standalone-no-research-artifacts
evals.prompt: [Clean project: no specs directory and no other skills.] Record this project input: I want a small tool that transcribes podcasts.
evals.expected_output: Create the ledger without refusing. Explicitly mark that no research artifacts are connected.

assertions.description: Missing upstream files do not cause refusal.
Research Candidates explicitly says no research artifacts are connected.
The user is not asked to create directories manually.

evals.name: placeholder-never-becomes-search-term
evals.prompt: The project has no name yet. Search for comparable products first.
evals.expected_output: Never search with a placeholder or temporary codename. Derive neutral terms from the user's words, search broad to narrow, and preserve the convergence record.

assertions.description: No placeholder or codename appears in queries.
Keywords trace to the user's nouns and verbs.
Broad-to-narrow convergence is recorded.

evals.name: does-not-take-over-research-dispatch
evals.prompt: Dispatch four agents in parallel to research product forms, resources, open source, and implementation options.
evals.expected_output: Do not dispatch the research. Identify the research-launch skill as owner and offer the adjacent ledger-update work.

assertions.description: No parallel research is dispatched.
The research-launch skill is identified as owner.

evals.name: existing-ledger-not-overwritten
evals.prompt: [The ledger has a handwritten note and three change-log entries.] Update it with the newly confirmed CLI platform.
evals.expected_output: Append the update, preserve the handwritten note and all three entries byte-for-byte, and add a fourth entry.

assertions.description: The handwritten note is unchanged.
The original entries retain content and order.
A new entry is appended rather than rewriting the file.
